role: Gate: replays the oracle's HostileProbe dump (zombie, skeleton, creeper, spider, enderman, witch, silverfish, pigman, blaze, cave spider, plus a probe player) through csrc/engine/hostiles*.c and living.c and compares every entity field, Random, NBT, removal and Det digest after each tick.

structs.name: splitref
structs.java: one Det split stream (determinize.sh static RNG name) per role

structs.name: ref
structs.java: the oracle's Det start.txt/end.txt snapshot (netherite.oracle.Det: world seed, per-role nextId, seeder/math digests, split streams)

notes: Test harness, built with -Dmain=gate_test_main behind tests/input_guard.c; not linked into the product and never on the tick path. make -C csrc test runs it on every directory under out/java/hostiles. Native calls: hostile_spawn, hostile_write_state (csrc/engine/hostiles.h), pigman_attack_entity_from (hostiles_pigman.h), an_init/an_tick/an_free, living_attack_entity_from, living_nbt_text, item_entity_nbt_text, world_*, det_*, nbt_parse/nbt_diff. native_kind maps the dump's kind 0..10 to HK_*; the record layout follows the manifest's ent_state_layout (pre-enderman dumps are 272+332 bytes). Oracle side: oracle/harness/netherite/oracle/HostileProbe.java. Recordings under out/java/hostiles (b-2, b-42, c-2, c-42, c-charged, e-2 and more). Per-class Java member lists are the behaviors the probe drives, not verified member by member.
